title: K-LOVE Names Gator Harrison as Chief Media Officer
summary: Gator Harrison will join K-LOVE in his new role on May 11.
contentText:
K-LOVE has named Gator Harrison as Chief Media Officer on its Ministry Leadership Team, where he will oversee the K-LOVE and Air1 radio networks, live events and partnerships. Harrison will officially join K-LOVE on May 11, 2026.

Harrison has worked for nearly 40 years in radio, most recently serving as senior vp of programming at iHeartMedia for over 10 years, where he oversaw broadcast, streaming, digital, social media and live events. Harrison also held other roles in radio since launching his career in 1986, including as program director, operations director and on-air personality.

Harrison has been honored by the Academy of Country Music and Country Music Association for his contributions to the country music genre. In 2015, he founded Believers, a ministry serving and discipling professionals in the music industry.

“I dedicated my life to Jesus in 1995 and prayed that He would allow me to do what I love, where I love, all for His glory,” Harrison said in a statement. “Through years of growth and preparation, He has faithfully answered that prayer. I am deeply grateful to iHeartMedia for their support and investment in my journey, and I am honored to join the K-LOVE and Air1 family.”

“We are thrilled to welcome such an outstanding industry expert to our team,” said Tom Stultz , K-LOVE CEO, in a statement. “His blend of expertise, coupled with the industry connections and ministry work he so loves, will enhance our mission and further position K-LOVE to inspire people to move closer to Jesus.”

Harrison added, “I’m humbled by this next chapter and thankful that God qualifies the unqualified. I look forward to continuing my life’s work of inspiring others to draw closer to Jesus.”

K-LOVE operates more than 1,100 radio signals alongside its sister network Air1, broadcasting in all 50 states and streaming globally.
